### Run Operations

#### Python

_No operation description provided._

```python
import json, os
from lib.embeddings.sweep import save_manifest

manifest = {{ manifest | tojson }}
save_manifest("{{ manifest_path }}", manifest)
with open(os.environ["STATE_FILE"], "w") as f:
    json.dump({"manifest_path": "{{ manifest_path }}", "entry_count": len(manifest)}, f)

```
